Senses.Explanation: The great smelter's refined gold should show no change of color — Xuedou's seal cast at the close of his picking of Baizhang's three-day deafness, then fought over for six centuries: some rule the gold itself deserves a shout, some find one man in the age who can tell its color, and some stamp it on the faces of the beaten. Yuanwu Keqin, commenting on Xuedou's picking in his beat-the-rhythm record, carries the line to its close: you people — want to see the three-day deafness? The great smelter's refined gold should show no change of color. This one sentence has sunk how many men. Xuedou wants to let his breath out: he bares one device, one setting, unbreakable for a thousand, for ten thousand ages — do not mistake it, all of you. Xueyan Zuqin, retelling the same strike in his raising-old section, rules the age color-blind: from old till now the old masters under heaven cannot tell yellow from green, beans from wheat — only Xuedou came a little closer, saying the great smelter's refined gold should show no change of color. Then he tries the verses that followed: Fenyang's — tracing the outline, no maker. Zhenjing's — a man of great strength turns it over within speech and silence. Dahui's — speaking reason is one thing; to see Mazu and Baizhang, far, far off. Yuejiang Zhengyin raises the strike with Xuedou's whole picking inside it, then rules: the lion's cub-taming device — Mazu had it. Baizhang went three days deaf, and fine food does not fill a man already full. Xuedou said the great smelter's refined gold should show no change of color — good, and give it a shout. The Kebin family. Tianyin Yuanxiu raises the case — Xinghua tells the steward Kebin he will soon be a teacher of the assembly; Kebin will not enter the society; beaten, fined five strings of cash, a meal laid on, expelled — and voices Yunju Shun: the great smelter's refined gold should show no change of color; the pity is Xinghua's command runs too strict — had it not been Kebin, who could have borne it? Today's shallow crew — how long could they keep their faces from turning? Tianyin: plainly so, plainly so. Then Dahui's counter — Yunju bends the crooked into the straight; to make a blazing descendant of Linji, you must turn the face-skin — and Tianyin closes: the old man is not luring you into lawbreaking; do you all know where this lands? Meet a swordsman on the road, show your sword; to one who is no poet, never offer poems. And Wanru Tongwei, raising the same case with both comments inside it: Yunju and Jingshan only work the face-skin; the single move of Xinghua and Kebin — that they never grope their way to. And yet — luckily there was then a face to let them vine upon. Were there no face, where would the two old men be now? Xiaotang Yunfen, opening the furnace for the closed retreat at Hongshan: the worn-out old fire-seed has already shown its light — the great smelter's refined gold should show no change of color. Here the buddhas of the three times strip off their greasy caps; here the six ancestors shed their falcon-foul shirts; the old masters of all the ages, ring within ring, pass the fragrance on. You patch-robed ones, five to a pair — south of the river, north of the Huai, through Qi, Lu, Yan, Zhao, Wu, Yue, Min, Guang — what wind blew you today to Hongshan's gate?
